name: Frequency Map
summary: Count or index values so repeated scanning becomes direct lookup.

name: Two Pointers
summary: Move two indices under an invariant to avoid testing every pair.

name: Sliding Window
summary: Maintain just enough state for a contiguous range as its boundaries move.
recognitionSignals: Longest, shortest, or count of contiguous ranges
commonMistakes: Shrinking only once when a loop is needed
Returning window size with wrong bounds

name: Prefix Sum
summary: Precompute cumulative state so range totals or balanced prefixes are cheap.

name: Binary Search
summary: Maintain an ordered search interval and discard half on each step.

name: Stack
summary: Keep unresolved items in last-in-first-out order.

name: Fast & Slow Pointers
summary: Advance pointers at different rates to reveal cycles or midpoints.

name: BFS
summary: Explore a graph level by level with a queue.

name: DFS
summary: Explore one branch fully before backtracking.

name: Topological Sort
summary: Order directed dependencies while detecting cycles.
commonMistakes: Not verifying all nodes were ordered

name: Union Find
summary: Maintain connected components under repeated merges.

name: Backtracking
summary: Choose, explore, and undo while pruning invalid partial solutions.

name: Heap Selection
summary: Keep the best k candidates or next priority available incrementally.
commonMistakes: Allowing heap to grow without bound

name: Trie
summary: Traverse character prefixes through a tree-shaped index.

name: 1D DP
summary: Build answers along one state dimension from previously solved positions.

name: 2D DP
summary: Track two changing dimensions such as grid position or paired prefixes.

name: Merge Intervals
summary: Sort ranges, then combine or select them using endpoint relationships.

name: Monotonic Stack
summary: Maintain candidates in increasing or decreasing order for nearest-boundary queries.
commonMistakes: Storing values when indices are needed

name: Greedy
summary: Commit to a local choice backed by a global invariant or exchange argument.

name: Bit Manipulation
summary: Use masks, shifts, and XOR identities to represent or transform state.
